memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Allergic rhinitis with mild intermittent symptoms.
Patient reports sneezing, clear nasal discharge and itchy eyes on waking, worse on dry days; examination shows pale boggy turbinates, clear nasal secretions, no polyps. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.30 L, FEV1/FVC 0.86; change from prior (none) +0.00 L. Technique checked: correct for nasal spray. Smoking status: never. Assessment: symptoms consistent with allergic rhinitis, lung function normal.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergy to grass pollen: seasonal allergic rhinitis with sneezing, nasal congestion, itchy eyes; confirmed by skin prick test.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Stable chronic kidney disease, allergic rhinitis controlled.
Patient reports reduced nasal symptoms, occasional mild dyspnoea on exertion; examination shows BP 138/84, lungs clear, no edema. Spirometry: FEV1 2.80 L (90% pred), FVC 3.25 L, FEV1/FVC 0.86; ΔFEV1 –0.05 L from last. Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never. Assessment: CKD stage G3aA2, allergic rhinitis well controlled; continue current meds.

Mild worsening of CKD, allergic rhinitis stable.
Patient notes occasional ankle swelling, fatigue; exam shows mild pitting edema to ankles, lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 2.78 L (89% pred), FVC 3.22 L, FEV1/FVC 0.86; ΔFEV1 –0.02 L. Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never. Assessment: CKD progression; consider renal protective adjustment.
